# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are generally provided for the latest maintained release of this project. Older releases and unsupported branches may not receive updates. Check the repository's releases and documentation for the current support status.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities through public issues, discussions, pull requests, or other public channels.

If private vulnerability reporting is available, use the **Report a vulnerability** option under this repository's **Security** tab. Otherwise, contact the maintainer privately using a contact method listed on the [maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/EduardoKrausME). Do not publish sensitive details until a private reporting channel has been established.

When reporting an issue, please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Affected versions, components, and configuration requirements.
- Steps to reproduce or a minimal proof of concept, without real credentials or personal data.
- Any known mitigations or suggested fixes.

Reports will be reviewed as maintainer availability permits. No specific response or resolution timeline is guaranteed. Please allow time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

## Scope

Security issues in third-party dependencies or the platforms on which this project runs may need to be reported to their respective maintainers. If the issue also affects this project, please include the relevant integration details in your private report.
